summary_en: Gunze approved acquisition of up to 1.0 million shares (3.17% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥4,000 million from November 6, 2026 to March 24, 2027, under its revised shareholder return policy announced in May 2025.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, Gunze's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.0 million treasury shares for a maximum expenditure of ¥4,000 million. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases from November 6, 2026 to March 24, 2027. Based on the reference data provided (31,368,015 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), the authorized share count represents 3.2% of outstanding shares. This buyback is executed under the revised shareholder return policy that the company adopted on May 14, 2025, aimed at providing stable and continuous returns to shareholders while sustaining long-term corporate value.
